question: The European Border and Coast Guard Agency (Frontex) uses aircraft and drones to monitor land and sea borders as part of its Multipurpose Aerial Surveillance (MAS) service. The aircraft are operated by private contractors. 1.
How many MAS operations took place in 2023 and 2024, and how many flight hours have been flown in this connection by airplanes and drones from contractors such as Airbus or DEA?
In which host countries have those operations taken place, in which of those countries have manned aircraft been used, and in which of them have unmanned aircraft been used?
How many sea rescue cases were reported during Frontex MAS airplane and drone operations in 2022, how many have been reported in 2023, and how many mayday alerts have been issued?
answer: EN on behalf of the European Commission (19.6.2024) As the question regarding ‘Multipurpose Aerial Surveillance operations in 2023 and 2024’ falls entirely under the responsibility of the European Border and Coast Guard Agency (Frontex), the Commission has asked the Agency to provide the details requested by the Honourable Member. The Agency’s reply will be sent by the Commission to the Honourable Member as soon as possible.
